title: AIxDaily
overview_zh: 今日精选：AI × Chem 4 项，AI × Bio 16 项，AI × Math 4 项，AI Voices 7 项，Engineering 6 项。今日五频道精选以预印本、公开帖文和 GitHub 趋势项目为主，未见入选的同行评议论文或正式软件发布。化学关注聚合物光化学与毒性建模提示稳健性；生物集中于单细胞和空间组学整合；数学聚焦空间推理与可检验评测；观点频道呈现公开立场；工程频道记录工具生态热度，均不应视为已获独立验证的定论。

channel_highlights.aixchem: 化学频道首三项均为预印本：光驱动聚合物后修饰、毒性预测提示工程，以及蛋白内在无序区预测；结论仍待同行评议与独立验证。
channel_highlights.aixbio: 生物频道的三项精选均为预印本，围绕通用基因表达空间、单细胞—空间组学整合及图谱级树编码，强调跨队列表示与可扩展性。
channel_highlights.aixmath: 数学频道前三项为 arXiv 预印本，涉及三维空间推理、漏洞补丁评测与知识冲突基准；后两项属于可检验性评估，不等同形式化证明。
channel_highlights.aivoices: 观点频道精选三则公开帖文：OpenAI 谈代理事件披露，ModelScope 发布自动驾驶模型主张，研究者转述多代理作弊风险；均非同行评议证据。
channel_highlights.engineering: 工程频道未纳入正式软件发布；首三项是 GitHub Trending 项目，覆盖智能体工作流、可复用技能与图表模板，热度不代表稳定性或独立测评。

breaking_news.headline_zh: Anthropic 公布费马大定理端到端 Lean 形式化
breaking_news.summary_zh: Anthropic 公布由 Claude 多智能体完成的费马大定理端到端 Lean 形式化：约 1,300 万行代码、29,500 个中间定理；该证明可由 Lean 内核检查。这不是新证明，而是将既有证明转化为可机器验证的代码产物。
breaking_news.why_breaking_zh: 费马大定理是数学史上最知名的问题之一；这一规模显示，AI 已能把高复杂度数学知识生产交付为可审计代码，并推动形式化数学的工作流变化。

items.title: Catalyst-Free, Visible-Light-Driven Hydrogenation and Giese Addition of N-Hydroxyphthalimide Ester–Containing Polymers Using Hantzsch Esters
items.abstract_or_text: To address unfavorable monomer reactivity ratios and catalyst deactivation during olefin copolymerization with polar vinyl monomers, alternative synthesis methods, such as the postfunctionalization of N-hydroxyphthalimide (NHPI) ester–containing polymers, have attracted significant attention. Although conventional hydrogenation methods have successfully yielded olefin copolymers, they are limited due to their reliance on toxic, unstable reagents and significant scale-up challenges. Thus, we explored the visible-light-driven reaction of electron donor–acceptor (EDA) complexes between NHPI esters and safe, inexpensive Hantzsch esters. In this study, we established a catalyst-free, visible-light-driven hydrogenation strategy for NHPI estercontaining polymers via EDA-complex-mediated decarboxylation of side-chain groups. This methodology enabled the synthesis of diverse olefin copolymers, including acrylates, polyacrylonitrile, and polystyrene, and advanced gram-scale reactions under natural sunlight. Furthermore, we demonstrated that the undesired polymer crosslinking commonly observed in acrylonitrile copolymer reactions could be effectively suppressed by adjusting the light intensity. This strategy was applied to Giese addition, achieving a high degree of functionalization of up to 79%. Overall, this strategy represents a milestone toward green, sustainable polymer synthesis.
items.summary_zh: 提出以NHPI ester–containing polymers与Hantzsch esters形成EDA complexes为基础的无催化剂、可见光驱动后官能化方法，通过侧链脱羧实现氢化，并扩展至Giese addition。该方法适用于acrylates、polyacrylonitrile和polystyrene等体系，可在自然日光下进行克级反应；调节光强可抑制acrylonitrile copolymer中的交联，Giese addition的官能化程度最高达79%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是将光化学EDA活化用于聚合物绿色后修饰的直接实验路线，可减少对有毒、不稳定氢化试剂和金属催化剂的依赖。证据限于预印本摘要所述的克级反应与特定聚合物体系，长期材料性能、底物广度及放大可行性仍需进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: 为解决极性乙烯基单体与烯烃共聚时不利的单体反应性比和催化剂失活问题，替代性合成方法——例如对含N-hydroxyphthalimide (NHPI) ester的聚合物进行后官能化——已受到广泛关注。尽管传统氢化方法已成功制得烯烃共聚物，但其依赖有毒、不稳定试剂且面临显著放大挑战，因而受到限制。因此，我们探索了NHPI esters与安全、廉价的Hantzsch esters之间电子供体–受体（EDA）complexes的可见光驱动反应。在本研究中，我们通过由EDA-complex介导的侧链基团脱羧，建立了一种针对含NHPI ester聚合物的无催化剂、可见光驱动氢化策略。该方法能够合成多种烯烃共聚物，包括acrylates、polyacrylonitrile和polystyrene，并可在自然日光下推进克级反应。此外，我们证明，通过调节光强，可有效抑制acrylonitrile copolymer反应中常见的不期望聚合物交联。该策略还被应用于Giese addition，实现了最高79%的高官能化程度。总体而言，该策略代表了迈向绿色、可持续聚合物合成的一个里程碑。
items.author_line: Yoichiro Eriguchi, Kosuke Sato, Shinsuke Inagi

items.title: Analysis of Prompt Engineering for Drug Toxicity Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Clinical trials in the UK can cost up to £1.3 million, with approximately 90% drug failure rate. Toxicity is a major contributing factor in drug failure. Testing is time and cost intensive. In recent years, the use of artificial intelligence has been increasingly explored to aid in the prediction of drug toxicity, with extensive use of large language models (LLMs). However, LLMs can show considerable variation when minor changes are made to prompts, which raises concerns about their sensitivity to prompt engineering. Prompt engineering is used to optimise a prompt given to an LLM to generate the desired output. This paper proposes a method to analyse prompt engineering for drug toxicity prediction. The aim of the paper is to investigate the importance of prompt phrasing for drug toxicity prediction. LLMs were prompted to identify chemical properties of significance when predicting drug toxicity. Prompts were constructed to investigate; job role, prompt structuring, and rule interpretation. LLMs were then used to generate datasets, using the identified features from initial prompting, which were then passed to machine learning algorithms. The experiments show that the natural variance which occurs in LLMs outweighs any fine-tuning of prompts. There were, however, substantial improvements in model performance when using chemoinformatic code to extract features instead of using LLM-generated values. The proposed analysis methodology is applicable to a wide range of prompt types across different areas of bioinformatics.
items.summary_zh: 系统考察LLMs在药物毒性预测中对角色设定、提示结构与规则解读等提示措辞的敏感性。作者先让LLMs识别毒性相关化学性质，再据此生成数据集并输入机器学习算法；实验显示LLM的自然随机变异大于提示微调带来的影响，而用cheminformatic code提取特征可显著提升模型性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作为药物毒性建模中“直接相信LLM生成性质”的做法提供了实证警示，并支持以可复现的化学信息学特征为主。摘要未报告独立临床或外部毒性基准验证，且为预印本，性能提升的范围与可推广性需审慎解读。
items.abstract_zh: 英国的临床试验成本最高可达130万英镑，药物失败率约为90%。毒性是导致药物失败的主要因素。毒性测试耗时且成本高昂。近年来，人们日益探索利用人工智能辅助药物毒性预测，其中广泛使用large language models (LLMs)。然而，对提示进行微小改动时，LLMs可能表现出相当大的变异，这引发了其对prompt engineering敏感性的担忧。Prompt engineering用于优化给定LLM的提示，以生成期望输出。本文提出了一种分析药物毒性预测中prompt engineering的方法。本文旨在研究提示措辞对药物毒性预测的重要性。研究人员提示LLMs识别预测药物毒性时具有重要意义的化学性质。构建提示以考察角色设定、提示结构和规则解读。随后，LLMs利用初始提示中识别出的特征生成数据集，这些数据集再被传递给机器学习算法。实验表明，LLMs中出现的自然变异超过了任何提示微调的影响。然而，使用cheminformatic code而非LLM生成的数值提取特征时，模型性能得到显著改善。所提出的分析方法适用于生物信息学不同领域中广泛的提示类型。
items.author_line: Mia MacGregor, Aakash Welgamage Don, Mark Bartlett

items.title: PredIDR3: A new output-encoding scheme and abundant negative source provide more information for deep learning-based protein intrinsic disorder prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Many computational methods to predict intrinsic disordered regions (IDRs) in proteins have been developed and their performances are blindly evaluated in community-driven assessment, Critical Assessment of protein Intrinsic Disorder (CAID). In this study, we developed PredIDR3 series, an updated version of PredIDR2 tested in CAID3 to accurately predict IDRs from protein sequences. It includes two methods depending on ensemble way. The performances of PredIDR3 series (AUC_ROC=0.953) are remarkably better than our previous PredIDR2 (AUC_ROC=0.936) on Disorder-PDB dataset of CAID3, which is thought to be mainly attributed to the use of more information for intrinsic disorder prediction based on deep convolutional neural network. In details, we introduced a new output-encoding scheme permitting a large sliding window (size=91) for the first time and extracted negative samples of the training set from non-IDRs of both PDB and DisProt databases, allowing to use more information for prediction of intrinsic disorder. PredIDR3 achieved comparable performance to the top-ranking methods of CAID3 in all criteria measured. PredIDR3 series can be freely available through the CAID Prediction Portal at https://caid.idpcentral.org/portal or downloaded as a Singularity container from https://biocomputingup.it/shared/caid-predictors/.
items.summary_zh: PredIDR3是用于从蛋白质序列预测内在无序区（IDRs）的深度卷积模型系列。其采用可容纳size=91滑动窗口的新输出编码，并从PDB和DisProt的非IDRs补充负样本；在CAID3的Disorder-PDB上，AUC_ROC由PredIDR2的0.936提高至0.953，且在CAID3各项指标上与领先方法相当，并提供CAID Prediction Portal与Singularity container访问。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 内在无序区预测可支持蛋白功能注释、结构研究和潜在靶点机制分析；该工作同时给出社区盲测背景下的量化比较与可部署实现。其结论仍基于预印本及CAID3/Disorder-PDB评估，面对新的蛋白家族和实验注释时的泛化能力仍待独立检验。
items.abstract_zh: 已经开发出许多用于预测蛋白质内在无序区（IDRs）的计算方法，其性能在由社区推动的蛋白质内在无序评估（Critical Assessment of protein Intrinsic Disorder, CAID）中接受盲测。在本研究中，我们开发了PredIDR3系列，这是在CAID3中测试的PredIDR2的更新版本，用于从蛋白质序列准确预测IDRs。它包含两种取决于集成方式的方法。PredIDR3系列在CAID3的Disorder-PDB数据集上表现为AUC_ROC=0.953，显著优于我们此前的PredIDR2（AUC_ROC=0.936）；这被认为主要归因于基于deep convolutional neural network、为内在无序预测使用了更多信息。具体而言，我们首次引入了一种允许使用大滑动窗口（size=91）的新输出编码方案，并从PDB和DisProt数据库中非IDRs提取训练集负样本，从而可利用更多信息预测内在无序。PredIDR3在所有测量标准上均达到与CAID3排名最高方法相当的性能。PredIDR3系列可通过CAID Prediction Portal（https://caid.idpcentral.org/portal）免费获取，或作为Singularity container从https://biocomputingup.it/shared/caid-predictors/下载。
items.author_line: Han, K.-S., Hwang, K., O, S.-M., Kim, S.-J., Ri, P.-Z., Choe, M.-M., Damiano, P.

items.title: Calibration of neural viscoelastic models via full-field data
items.abstract_or_text: We propose an unsupervised learning framework for calibrating a physics-augmented neural network (PANN) for small-strain viscoelasticity via full-field data. It only requires quantities that are directly accessible in real experiments for training, namely global reaction forces and surface displacements. The underlying PANN is embedded in the generalized standard materials theory, in which two scalar-valued potentials render the constitutive model thermodynamically consistent by construction, while invariant-based representations of the free energy and the dual dissipation potential additionally ensure material symmetry. Considering a thin specimen under the plane stress assumption, we formulate a constrained optimization problem based on the equilibrium gap method in combination with quasi-Newton optimizers and automatic differentiation. Thereby, the unknown out-of-plane strain follows from the plane stress condition and the evolution of the internal variables is captured by an implicit time integration scheme. The resulting system of nonlinear equations is solved via a local Newton iteration at quadrature point and time step. To drastically reduce the computational cost of training, the backward adjoint method is employed to compute the gradient of the target loss, instead of backpropagating through all Newton iteration steps. The proposed framework is demonstrated for synthetic data, including noisy displacements and forces, showing excellent agreement across a wide range of deformation rates and load paths.
items.summary_zh: 提出以全场实验数据校准小应变粘弹性physics-augmented neural network (PANN)的无监督框架，只需全局反力和表面位移。模型嵌入generalized standard materials theory以保证热力学一致性和材料对称性，并以equilibrium gap、quasi-Newton optimization、automatic differentiation、隐式时间积分及backward adjoint降低训练成本；在含噪声位移和力的合成数据上，跨不同变形速率和加载路径获得良好一致性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该框架将物理约束神经本构模型与实验可观测的全场力学数据相连接，有望减少粘弹性材料模型标定对难测内部变量的依赖。当前验证仅为合成数据，尚无真实材料实验、跨材料迁移或长期数值稳定性的证据。
items.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种无监督学习框架，用于通过全场数据校准小应变粘弹性的physics-augmented neural network (PANN)。训练只需要在真实实验中可直接获取的量，即全局反力和表面位移。底层PANN嵌入generalized standard materials theory，其中两个标量值势函数使本构模型在构造上满足热力学一致性；而自由能和对偶耗散势的基于不变量的表征还确保了材料对称性。考虑平面应力假设下的薄试样，我们基于equilibrium gap method，结合quasi-Newton optimizers和automatic differentiation，构建了一个约束优化问题。因此，未知的面外应变由平面应力条件确定，内部变量的演化由隐式时间积分方案捕捉。所得非线性方程组在每个积分点和时间步通过局部Newton iteration求解。为显著降低训练计算成本，我们采用backward adjoint method计算目标损失的梯度，而不是对所有Newton iteration步骤进行反向传播。所提出的框架在合成数据上得到展示，其中包括带噪声的位移和力，并在广泛的变形速率和加载路径下显示出优异的一致性。
items.author_line: Brain M. Riemer, Markus Kästner, Karl A. Kalina

items.title: Generative atlasing in universal gene expression space defines cell types and microenvironment spectra during disease progression
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Cells execute core physiological functions through intricate molecular networks. Elucidating these network principles is critical for understanding disease progression. However, most current transformer-based single-cell foundation models rely on encoder-only architectures that output abstract latent embeddings lacking explicit biological interpretability. An effective generative framework must quantitatively map these latent coordinates back into the biological real space of gene expression. To achieve this, we present UniGeneX, a generative single-cell foundation model that reconstructs large-scale, multi-dataset transcriptomics data into a quantitative space of Universal Gene Expression (UGE). By constructing the UGE space, UniGeneX effectively disentangles the molecular spectra of cell states across health and disease. This generative framework seamlessly integrates single-cell cohorts and spatial transcriptomics (ST) data, facilitating cell-type identification and niche architecture mapping. Applying UniGeneX to pulmonary fibrosis (PF) and glioma cohorts, we demonstrate its utility in constructing comprehensive tissue atlases, tracking disease progression along a spatial niche pseudotime, and identifying localized vascular zonation programs associated with tumor cellular state transitions.
items.summary_zh: UniGeneX 将多队列转录组重建到可量化的 Universal Gene Expression (UGE) 空间，并用于肺纤维化和胶质瘤的单细胞—空间图谱分析。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本尝试把单细胞基础模型的潜变量映射回可解释的基因表达空间，为跨队列整合、空间生态位刻画和疾病状态比较提供统一表示。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：细胞通过复杂的分子网络执行核心生理功能。阐明这些网络的原理对于理解疾病进展至关重要。然而，当前大多数基于 transformer 的单细胞基础模型依赖仅编码器架构，输出缺乏明确生物学可解释性的抽象潜在嵌入。有效的生成式框架必须将这些潜在坐标定量映射回基因表达的生物学真实空间。为此，我们提出 UniGeneX，这是一种生成式单细胞基础模型，可将大规模、多数据集转录组数据重建至 Universal Gene Expression (UGE) 的定量空间。通过构建 UGE 空间，UniGeneX 能够有效解耦健康与疾病状态下细胞状态的分子谱。该生成式框架无缝整合单细胞队列和空间转录组学 (ST) 数据，促进细胞类型鉴定和生态位结构绘图。将 UniGeneX 应用于肺纤维化 (PF) 和胶质瘤队列时，我们展示了其构建综合组织图谱、沿空间生态位伪时间追踪疾病进展，以及识别与肿瘤细胞状态转换相关的局部血管分区程序的效用。
items.author_line: Wu A, Wan X, Yu L, Chen Y, Xiao J, He M, Yang C

items.title: FADVI: disentangled representation learning for robust integration of single-cell and spatial omics data
items.abstract_or_text: Integrating single-cell and spatial omics data remains challenging due to strong batch effects across experiments and platforms. Existing methods focus on minimizing these effects but cannot disentangle technical variation from true biological signals. Here, we present FADVI, a variational autoencoder framework partitioning the latent space into batch-specific, label-related, and residual subspaces. By combining supervised classification, adversarial training, and cross-covariance penalty, FADVI disentangles batch from biological representations, preserving biological variation while correcting batch effects. Benchmarking across scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, and high-resolution spatial transcriptomics datasets, FADVI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art integration methods. FADVI also enables feature attribution for revealing genes associated with cell type identity and batch variation. Together, these results demonstrate that FADVI provides robust, interpretable integration for large-scale single-cell and spatial omics data, offering a powerful framework for downstream analysis and discovery.
items.summary_zh: FADVI 以变分自编码器分离批次、标签相关和残余子空间，在 scRNA-seq、scATAC-seq 与高分辨率空间转录组基准中评估整合表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本将批次校正与生物学表示显式分解，并提供特征归因；其相对性能仍需在独立数据和真实下游任务中复核。
items.abstract_zh: 整合单细胞和空间组学数据仍具挑战性，因为不同实验和平台之间存在强烈的批次效应。现有方法侧重于最小化这些效应，但无法将技术变异与真实生物学信号解耦。本文提出 FADVI，一种将潜在空间划分为批次特异、标签相关和残余子空间的变分自编码器框架。通过结合监督分类、对抗训练和交叉协方差惩罚，FADVI 将批次表示与生物学表示解耦，在校正批次效应的同时保留生物学变异。在 scRNA-seq、scATAC-seq 和高分辨率空间转录组数据集上的基准测试中，FADVI 持续优于最先进的整合方法。FADVI 还可进行特征归因，以揭示与细胞类型身份和批次变异相关的基因。总之，这些结果表明 FADVI 为大规模单细胞和空间组学数据提供稳健、可解释的整合，为下游分析和发现提供了有力框架。
items.author_line: Liu, W., Qu, G., Simon, L. M., Theis, F. J., Zhao, Z.

items.title: Global tree encoding of atlas-scale single-cell genomics
items.abstract_or_text: The rapid expansion of single-cell genomic datasets has led to the compilation of biological resources comprising hundreds of millions of cells across tissues, developmental stages, and disease states. This has underscored the need for scalable and interpretable data representations that preserve the complex relationships and multi-scale organization of cellular states, while remaining computationally tractable at atlas scale. Existing approaches based on discrete abstractions have enabled cell annotation, clustering, and trajectory inference, but are often optimized for local inference tasks and may obscure continuous cellular relationships and multi-resolution structure within complex transcriptional and other genomic landscapes. Moreover, increasing dataset sizes often require information-reduction strategies such as random downsampling, limiting the resolution of rare cell populations and heterogeneous cellular states. Here, we present MILK, a scalable computational framework that organizes high-dimensional single-cell populations into unified tree representations. Across large-scale transcriptomic atlases, MILK enables representative subsampling with preserved information, supporting the tractable application of existing algorithms for tasks including deep generative model training and foundation model benchmarking. Additionally, MILK enables holistic, multi-resolution analyses that capture global developmental trajectories, characterize disease-associated cellular perturbations across tissues, and facilitate comparison of transcriptional programs across species within a coherent hierarchical framework. Together, these results establish the hierarchical organization of biological data as a scalable and unifying representation of cellular identity, enabling integrative analysis of single-cell genomic data across diverse contexts.
items.summary_zh: MILK 将高维单细胞群体组织为统一树表示，面向图谱尺度的代表性抽样、生成模型训练、基础模型基准和跨物种比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本关注数亿细胞图谱的可扩展、可解释表示，试图减少随机降采样对罕见细胞和异质状态分辨率的损失。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞基因组数据集的快速扩张促成了生物资源的汇编，其中包含跨组织、发育阶段和疾病状态的数亿个细胞。这凸显出对可扩展且可解释的数据表示的需求：这种表示应在图谱尺度上保持计算可处理性，同时保留细胞状态的复杂关系和多尺度组织。基于离散抽象的现有方法已支持细胞注释、聚类和轨迹推断，但它们通常针对局部推断任务优化，并且可能掩盖复杂转录组及其他基因组景观中的连续细胞关系和多分辨率结构。此外，数据集规模不断增大往往需要随机降采样等信息降维策略，从而限制了罕见细胞群和异质细胞状态的分辨率。本文提出 MILK，这是一种将高维单细胞群体组织为统一树表示的可扩展计算框架。在大规模转录组图谱中，MILK 支持保留信息的代表性子采样，从而可处理地应用现有算法于深度生成模型训练和基础模型基准等任务。此外，MILK 支持整体性、多分辨率分析，可捕捉全局发育轨迹、刻画跨组织的疾病相关细胞扰动，并在连贯的层级框架内促进跨物种转录程序比较。总之，这些结果确立了生物数据的层级组织作为细胞身份的一种可扩展且统一的表示，使得能够在多样化背景下整合分析单细胞基因组数据。
items.author_line: Kiyota, B., Lee, C., Yao, H., Yachie, N.

items.title: Adding layers of information to scRNA-seq data using pre-trained language models
items.abstract_or_text: Pre-trained language models promise to enrich single-cell analyses with contextual information from large biomedical text corpora, but it remains unclear how to optimally align this knowledge with quantitative scRNA-seq data. To address this, we construct text-based training datasets from both scRNA-seq data and biomedical literature targeted to the experimental setting at hand. We then fine-tune lightweight encoder-only biomedical language models to learn a shared, literature-enriched representation. Controlled evaluations across immune and developmental datasets show that this representation preserves cell identity while adding robust and interpretable contextual layers of functional, disease-associated, and developmental information to single-cell analysis workflows.
items.summary_zh: 该研究用实验场景对应的 scRNA-seq 和生物医学文献构建文本训练集，微调轻量级生物医学语言模型以获得文献增强的单细胞表示。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 受控免疫和发育数据集评估提示，文本知识可在保留细胞身份的同时增加可解释的功能和疾病关联语境；结论目前属于预印本层面的数据集验证。
items.abstract_zh: 预训练语言模型有望以大型生物医学文本语料库中的上下文信息丰富单细胞分析，但如何将这些知识与定量 scRNA-seq 数据最佳对齐仍不明确。为解决这一问题，我们从 scRNA-seq 数据和面向当前实验场景的生物医学文献中构建基于文本的训练数据集。随后，我们微调轻量级、仅编码器的生物医学语言模型，以学习共享的、经文献增强的表示。在免疫和发育数据集上的受控评估表明，这一表示在保留细胞身份的同时，为单细胞分析工作流增加了稳健且可解释的功能、疾病相关和发育信息上下文层。
items.author_line: Krissmer, S. M., Menger, J., Rollin, J., Vogel, T. M., Binder, H., Hackenberg, M.

items.title: Deep visual proteomics reveals distinct proximal tubular and glomerular injury programs in experimental diabetic kidney disease
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Diabetic kidney disease (DKD) is the leading cause of chronic kidney disease (CKD). However, most proteomic studies of DKD rely on bulk kidney tissue, which cannot distinguish the contribution or response of individual nephron compartments to injury. Methods: Diabetes was induced in male mice by streptozotocin (STZ) injections. After 16-weeks, the mice and vehicle-treated controls were characterized physiologically, biochemically, and histologically. A deep learning-powered Deep Visual Proteomics (DVP) pipeline, validated against manual annotation, was adapted to isolate proximal tubule (PT) and glomeruli from Megalin stained kidney sections by automated laser microdissection. Bulk kidney, PT, and glomerular proteomes were generated by data independent acquisition mass spectrometry. PT-enriched candidates were prioritized using a composite scoring approach and compared with human tubulointerstitial proteomic data from the Kidney Precision Medicine Project. Results: STZ mice developed sustained hyperglycaemia and albuminuria, alongside elevated markers of tubular injury and interstitial fibrosis. Segmentation models isolated PT and glomeruli with high fidelity (Dice coefficients 0.878 and 0.914; area correlations r=0.993 and r=0.996). Compartment-resolved proteomics determined that PT and glomeruli underwent largely distinct, non-overlapping remodelling: PT exhibited loss of proteostatic, cell cycle, and structural programs with compensatory mitochondrial and lipid metabolic upregulation, whereas glomeruli showed broad loss of oxidative metabolic capacity without any compensatory metabolic program. Fourteen of the top twenty prioritized PT candidates, including LARS2 and ANXA2, changed in the same direction in human CKD tubulointerstitial proteomic data. The STZ PT proteome correlated significantly with this human dataset, while the glomerular comparison did not. Conclusions: Compartment-resolved and deep learning-guided visual proteomics can uncover divergent, biologically coherent PT and glomerular injury programs in DKD that are masked in bulk tissue analysis. A PT injury signature was uncovered that is partially conserved in human CKD, identifying novel candidate mechanisms and biomarkers for future exploration.
items.summary_zh: 深度学习引导的 Deep Visual Proteomics 在 STZ 糖尿病小鼠中分辨近端小管与肾小球蛋白质组重塑，并与人类 CKD 肾小管间质数据比较。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 分区蛋白质组学揭示了整体肾组织分析可能掩盖的差异性损伤程序；人类数据支持近端小管信号部分保守，但不构成机制或临床生物标志物验证。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：糖尿病肾病 (DKD) 是慢性肾病 (CKD) 的首要病因。然而，大多数 DKD 蛋白质组研究依赖整体肾组织，因而无法区分各肾单位区室对损伤的贡献或反应。方法：通过链脲佐菌素 (STZ) 注射在雄性小鼠中诱导糖尿病。16 周后，对小鼠和接受载体处理的对照进行生理、生化和组织学表征。我们采用经人工注释验证的深度学习驱动 Deep Visual Proteomics (DVP) 流程，通过自动激光显微切割从 Megalin 染色的肾切片中分离近端小管 (PT) 和肾小球。采用数据非依赖采集质谱生成整体肾、PT 和肾小球蛋白质组。使用综合评分方法优先排序 PT 富集候选物，并与 Kidney Precision Medicine Project 的人类肾小管间质蛋白质组数据进行比较。结果：STZ 小鼠出现持续高血糖和白蛋白尿，同时伴有肾小管损伤和间质纤维化标志物升高。分割模型以高保真度分离 PT 和肾小球，Dice 系数分别为 0.878 和 0.914，面积相关系数 r 分别为 0.993 和 0.996。区室分辨蛋白质组学确定，PT 和肾小球经历了大体不同且不重叠的重塑：PT 出现蛋白稳态、细胞周期和结构程序丧失，以及代偿性线粒体和脂质代谢上调；肾小球则广泛丧失氧化代谢能力，但未出现任何代偿性代谢程序。优先排序的前二十个 PT 候选物中有十四个，包括 LARS2 和 ANXA2，在人类 CKD 肾小管间质蛋白质组数据中呈相同方向变化。STZ PT 蛋白质组与该人类数据集显著相关，而肾小球比较并非如此。结论：区室分辨、深度学习引导的视觉蛋白质组学可揭示 DKD 中在整体组织分析中被掩盖的、不同且生物学连贯的 PT 和肾小球损伤程序。研究发现了在人体 CKD 中部分保守的 PT 损伤特征，识别出有待进一步探索的新候选机制和生物标志物。
items.author_line: Zheng, X., d'Acierno, M., Rosenbaek, L. K., Rinschen, M., Wu, Q., Fenton, R. A.

items.title: TDEP: Predicting Target Perturbation Response from Drug-Induced Transcriptomes
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract BackgroundAccurate prediction of drug-target interactions (DTIs) is critical for drug discovery, yet structure-based methods offer little insight into the biological consequences of target engagement, and omics-based methods rely on shRNA profiles susceptible to off-target noise. Both yield only binary labels, with no gene-level account of target inhibition.ResultsWe present TDEP (Target-perturbed Differential Expression Profile), a deep neural network that predicts transcriptome-wide responses to target inhibition by combining pretrained protein language model embeddings with graph attention network propagation over a co-expression network, trained on LINCS Connectivity Map drug-induced transcriptomes under DTI supervision. On an unseen-drug benchmark, TDEP reached a mean AUROC of 0.873, comparable to the strongest structure-based baselines (DrugBAN 0.848; GraphDTA 0.828) and far above omics-based baselines (ssGCN 0.593; FRoGS 0.524). Ablation analysis revealed complementary roles of the two architectural modules across unseen-drug and unseen-target generalization regimes, and multi-cell ensemble prediction demonstrated cross-cell transferability (mean AUROC 0.899 same-cell, 0.888 cross-cell, 0.910 multi-cell ensemble). Gene-level outputs provide a basis for mechanistic interpretation and target prioritization.ConclusionsTDEP matches structure-based accuracy while additionally yielding transcriptome-wide, target-level perturbation profiles. Coverage is limited to Connectivity Map ligands and cancer cell lines, within which TDEP supports target prioritization, mechanistic hypothesis generation and drug repurposing.
items.summary_zh: TDEP 结合预训练蛋白语言模型、共表达网络图注意力和 LINCS Connectivity Map 药物转录组，预测靶点抑制后的全转录组反应。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型在未见药物基准上报告 AUROC 0.873，并输出基因层面的扰动预测；其适用范围被作者限定于 Connectivity Map 配体和癌细胞系。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：背景：准确预测药物—靶点相互作用 (DTI) 对药物发现至关重要，但基于结构的方法几乎无法说明靶点结合的生物学后果，而基于组学的方法依赖易受脱靶噪声影响的 shRNA 谱。两者均只产生二元标签，无法在基因层面说明靶点抑制。结果：我们提出 TDEP (Target-perturbed Differential Expression Profile)，一种深度神经网络；该网络将预训练蛋白语言模型嵌入与共表达网络上的图注意力网络传播结合，在 DTI 监督下使用 LINCS Connectivity Map 药物诱导转录组进行训练。在未见药物基准中，TDEP 的平均 AUROC 达到 0.873，与最强的基于结构的基线方法相当，DrugBAN 为 0.848、GraphDTA 为 0.828，并远高于基于组学的基线，ssGCN 为 0.593、FRoGS 为 0.524。消融分析显示，两个架构模块在未见药物和未见靶点泛化情境中发挥互补作用；多细胞系集成预测展示了跨细胞系可迁移性，平均 AUROC 为同细胞系 0.899、跨细胞系 0.888、多细胞系集成 0.910。基因层面输出为机制解释和靶点优先级排序提供了基础。结论：TDEP 在保持基于结构方法准确性的同时，还产生全转录组、靶点层面的扰动谱。其覆盖范围限于 Connectivity Map 配体和癌细胞系；在这一范围内，TDEP 支持靶点优先级排序、机制假设生成和药物再定位。
items.author_line: Sung J, Kim S, Kim W

items.title: Colorimetric/chemiluminescent vertical flow immunoassay based on multifunctional cobalt–gold bimetallic nanoclusters for Brucella antibody detection and deep learning- assisted semiquantitative analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract colorimetric/chemiluminescent vertical flow immunoassay (VFI) based on glutathione-protected cobalt–gold bimetallic nanoclusters (GSH@Co–AuNCs) conjugated with staphylococcal protein A as multifunctional catalytic immunoprobes. The probe integrates immunorecognition with peroxidase-like activity, enabling direct colorimetric visualization, nanozyme-amplified colorimetry through 3,3′,5,5′-tetramethylbenzidine–H₂O₂ oxidation, and sustained luminol–H₂O₂ chemiluminescence within a common assay architecture. Direct colorimetry remained reliably distinguishishable at 0.5 IU mL⁻¹, whereas nanozyme-amplified colorimetry and chemiluminescence both reached 0.2 IU mL⁻¹. The chemiluminescent system additionally exhibited sustained emission for more than 150 min, providing low-background imaging and a broader signal-acquisition window for weak responses. To standardize image interpretation, separate shared-weight dual-branch 18-layer residual network models were developed for nanozyme-amplified colorimetric and chemiluminescent images, yielding internal-test R2 values of 0.9647 and 0.9734, respectively. In a preliminary evaluation of 30 clinical serum samples using the serum agglutination test as the reference, nanozyme-amplified colorimetry achieved 95.0% sensitivity, 90.0% specificity, and 93.3% accuracy, while chemiluminescence achieved 95.0%, 100%, and 96.7%, respectively. This work not only demonstrates the integration of multifunctional nanocluster catalysis, sustained chemiluminescence, and regression-based semiquantitative analysis within a single VFI platform, but also provides a general strategy for improving weak-signal discrimination and standardized interpretation in portable immunoassays.
items.summary_zh: GSH@Co–AuNCs 垂直流免疫检测整合显色、化学发光和双分支 ResNet 半定量读图，并在30份临床血清样本中做初步评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本把纳米酶信号放大与图像标准化解读置于同一便携检测架构；临床证据样本量仅30，尚不足以确定真实世界诊断性能。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：一种基于谷胱甘肽保护的钴—金双金属纳米簇 (GSH@Co–AuNCs) 并与葡萄球菌蛋白 A 偶联的比色/化学发光垂直流免疫分析 (VFI)，用作多功能催化免疫探针。该探针将免疫识别与类过氧化物酶活性整合，可在共同的检测架构内实现直接比色可视化、通过 3,3′,5,5′-四甲基联苯胺–H₂O₂ 氧化实现的纳米酶放大比色，以及持续的鲁米诺–H₂O₂ 化学发光。直接比色在 0.5 IU mL⁻¹ 时仍可可靠区分，而纳米酶放大比色和化学发光均达到 0.2 IU mL⁻¹。化学发光系统还表现出超过 150 min 的持续发射，为微弱响应提供低背景成像和更宽的信号采集窗口。为标准化图像解读，我们分别针对纳米酶放大比色图像和化学发光图像开发了共享权重的双分支 18 层残差网络模型，内部测试 R2 分别为 0.9647 和 0.9734。在以血清凝集试验为参考的30份临床血清样本初步评估中，纳米酶放大比色的灵敏度为95.0%、特异度为90.0%、准确度为93.3%，而化学发光分别为95.0%、100%和96.7%。该工作不仅展示了在单一 VFI 平台内整合多功能纳米簇催化、持续化学发光和基于回归的半定量分析，还为提升便携式免疫分析中微弱信号的区分能力和标准化解读提供了通用策略。
items.author_line: Bi H, Zhao X, Wei M, Li X, Wu J, Wang Y, Zhang X, Ma H, Zhou H, xu z, Guo K, Jiang Y, shi F

items.title: A Human Neuronal Cell Model of Endogenous TDP-43 A315T Reveals Altered Protein Dynamics and Disease-Relevant Cellular Dysfunction
items.abstract_or_text: TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) aggregation is the defining pathological hallmark of nearly all cases of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), yet physiologically relevant human models that faithfully recapitulate disease-associated TDP-43 proteinopathy and dysfunction remain limited. To cover this gap, we generated a novel human-based model of cortical neurons carrying the endogenous ALS-linked TDP-43 A315T mutation together with an in-frame Dendra2 fluorescent reporter, enabling temporal and spatial monitoring of the protein. Neurons expressing TDP-43 A315T exhibited progressive neurite degeneration, altered neuronal activity, and impaired mitochondrial respiration, recapitulating several ALS-associated phenotypes. Our model also displays autophagy-dependent accumulation of cytoplasmic aggregates of mutant TDP-43 without overt loss of nuclear function, maintaining normal processing of canonical cryptic exon targets. In contrast, experimental induction of TDP-43 nuclear exclusion readily triggered cryptic exon incorporation, demonstrating that the model faithfully reproduces loss-of-function phenotypes under stress conditions. In line with perturbed protein solubility, mutant TDP-43 neurons show increased stress granule (SG) formation at baseline and under oxidative stress condition. Finally, treatment with the RNA chaperone Clip34 significantly reduced TDP-43 aggregation under both basal and oxidative stress conditions as well as its localization to SGs. Taken together, these findings establish a physiologically relevant human model that separates early TDP-43 toxic gain-of-function from basal loss-of-function while providing a robust platform for investigating TDP-43 biology and accelerating therapeutic discovery in ALS.
items.summary_zh: 内源性 TDP-43 A315T/Dendra2 人皮层神经元模型呈现神经突退化、线粒体呼吸受损、应激颗粒增加和突变蛋白聚集；Clip34 处理降低聚集。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本提供可时空监测的 ALS 相关人源细胞模型，并区分早期毒性获得功能与基础丧失功能表型；Clip34 结果仍是体外模型中的药效线索。
items.abstract_zh: TAR DNA 结合蛋白 43 (TDP-43) 聚集是几乎所有肌萎缩侧索硬化症 (ALS) 病例的定义性病理标志，但能够忠实再现疾病相关 TDP-43 蛋白病和功能障碍的、生理相关的人源模型仍然有限。为弥补这一缺口，我们构建了一种新的人源皮层神经元模型：其携带内源性 ALS 相关 TDP-43 A315T 突变及同框 Dendra2 荧光报告基因，能够对该蛋白进行时间和空间监测。表达 TDP-43 A315T 的神经元表现出进行性神经突退化、神经元活动改变和线粒体呼吸受损，重现了若干 ALS 相关表型。我们的模型还表现出依赖自噬的突变 TDP-43 胞质聚集体累积，但没有明显的核功能丧失，并维持对经典隐蔽外显子靶标的正常加工。相反，实验诱导 TDP-43 核排除可容易地触发隐蔽外显子掺入，表明该模型能在应激条件下忠实再现功能丧失表型。与蛋白溶解性受扰一致，突变 TDP-43 神经元在基础状态和氧化应激状态下均显示应激颗粒 (SG) 形成增加。最后，RNA 伴侣 Clip34 治疗在基础和氧化应激条件下均显著降低 TDP-43 聚集及其在 SG 中的定位。总之，这些发现建立了一个生理相关的人源模型，它将早期 TDP-43 毒性获得功能与基础功能丧失分开，并提供稳健平台以研究 TDP-43 生物学和加速 ALS 治疗发现。
items.author_line: Cicardi, M. E., Antonini, S., Martorell Serra, I., Muench, M., Kinney, N., Girdhar, A., Cristofani, R., Poletti, A., Sterneckert, J., Crippa, V., Bordi, M., Pasinelli, P., Guo, L., Tigano, M., Trotti, D.

items.title: Diffusive ssDNA surveillance and bidirectional exoribonucleolytic digestion by RNase H2 ensure thorough clearance of RNA–DNA hybrids
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract RNase H2 has long been acknowledged as a specialized endonuclease that preserves genomic stability by selectively degrading the RNA moiety of RNA–DNA hybrids (RDHs) and R-loops. However, how RNase H2 achieves efficient and thorough substrate clearance despite its low cellular abundance remains inadequately addressed. Here, we explore the dynamics of RNase H2 processing hybrid substrates at the single-molecule level. We find that following RNA removal, RNase H2 remains bound to the resulting ssDNA products. Taking advantage of a positively charged intrinsically disordered region, RNase H2 can undergo fast and persistent one-dimensional diffusion along ssDNA. Remarkably, upon encountering RNA segments, the diffusing enzyme acts as a bidirectional exoribonuclease and processively eliminates them. Coating of ssDNA by the prevalent ssDNA-binding protein RPA constrains both the diffusion and exoribonucleolytic processivity of RNase H2. Collectively, our findings support a ssDNA-based “surveil-and-eliminate” mechanism by which RNase H2 ensures comprehensive RDH clearance.
items.summary_zh: 单分子实验提出 RNase H2 在移除 RNA 后沿 ssDNA 一维扩散，遇到 RNA 片段时以双向外切核糖核酸酶方式持续清除 RNA–DNA 杂交体。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本为低丰度 RNase H2 如何广泛清除 RDH/R-loop 提出可检验的“监视并清除”机制，同时指出 RPA 包被会限制该过程。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：RNase H2 长期以来被认为是一种专门的内切核酸酶，可通过选择性降解 RNA–DNA 杂交体 (RDHs) 和 R-loops 中的 RNA 部分来维持基因组稳定性。然而，尽管细胞丰度较低，RNase H2 如何实现高效而彻底的底物清除仍未得到充分解释。本文在单分子水平探索 RNase H2 处理杂交底物的动力学。我们发现，在 RNA 被移除后，RNase H2 仍结合于由此产生的 ssDNA 产物。借助一个带正电荷的内在无序区，RNase H2 可沿 ssDNA 进行快速而持续的一维扩散。值得注意的是，当遇到 RNA 片段时，扩散中的酶会作为双向外切核糖核酸酶发挥作用，并持续地将其清除。常见 ssDNA 结合蛋白 RPA 对 ssDNA 的包被限制了 RNase H2 的扩散及其外切核糖核酸酶过程性。总体而言，我们的发现支持一种基于 ssDNA 的“监视并清除”机制，RNase H2 借此确保对 RDH 的全面清除。
items.author_line: Sun B, Zhao Y, Zhang Y, Li Y, Cheng B, Zhang X, Ma X, Chen L, Wu S, Chen J, Liu C, Liu C, Li W

items.title: Systematic Modality Ablation of Multimodal Machine Learning for Predicting 24-Month Progression from Mild Cognitive Impairment to Alzheimer's Disease
items.abstract_or_text: Multimodal biomarkers have transformed Alzheimer's disease research, but the incremental contribution of individual modalities to predicting progression from mild cognitive impairment (MCI) remains unclear. We systematically evaluated the contribution of demographic, cognitive, genetic, structural imaging, cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), and positron emission tomography (PET) biomarkers using a comprehensive ablation framework. We analyzed 2,430 participants with MCI from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative with known 24-month progression status. XGBoost models were trained using combinations of demographic variables, cognitive assessments, apolipoprotein E (APOE) genotype, structural MRI, CSF biomarkers, and PET biomarkers. Performance was evaluated using repeated stratified 5X10 cross-validation, with out-of-fold AUC comparisons and Holm-Bonferroni correction. Sensitivity analyses assessed the effects of missing-data handling. The full multimodal model achieved the highest discrimination (AUC=0.934). Excluding cognitive assessments produced the largest reduction in performance (AUC=0.883, P<0.001). Removing APOE, CSF, or MRI produced only modest reductions (AUC=0.933, 0.931, and 0.932, respectively). PET produced a similarly small reduction in the primary analysis (AUC=0.932), although complete-case analysis indicated that imputation significantly inflated its performance (P=0.005), suggesting that its contribution may be underestimated or obscured by missingness. The baseline clinical model performed near chance (AUC=0.556). These findings establish an evidence-based hierarchy of biomarker contributions and provide a quantitative framework for prioritizing biomarker acquisition and designing cost-effective multimodal prediction models.
items.summary_zh: 基于 ADNI 2,430名 MCI 参与者的系统消融分析显示，24个月进展预测中认知评估的移除造成最大 AUC 降幅；完整多模态 XGBoost 的 AUC 为0.934。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究量化多模态生物标志物的相对增益并检查缺失值影响，可为预测研究的采集优先级提供参考；这是交叉验证研究，未报告独立临床部署验证。
items.abstract_zh: 多模态生物标志物已改变阿尔茨海默病研究，但各个模态对预测轻度认知障碍 (MCI) 向阿尔茨海默病24个月进展的增量贡献仍不清楚。我们采用全面消融框架，系统评估了人口统计学、认知、遗传、结构成像、脑脊液 (CSF) 和正电子发射断层扫描 (PET) 生物标志物的贡献。我们分析了阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议中2,430名具有已知24个月进展状态的 MCI 参与者。使用人口统计变量、认知评估、载脂蛋白 E (APOE) 基因型、结构 MRI、CSF 生物标志物和 PET 生物标志物的组合训练 XGBoost 模型。使用重复分层 5×10 交叉验证评估性能，并进行折外 AUC 比较和 Holm-Bonferroni 校正。敏感性分析评估了缺失数据处理的影响。完整多模态模型取得最高区分度 (AUC=0.934)。排除认知评估造成最大的性能降低 (AUC=0.883，P<0.001)。移除 APOE、CSF 或 MRI 仅造成轻度降低，AUC 分别为0.933、0.931和0.932。PET 在主要分析中也仅造成较小降低 (AUC=0.932)，但完整病例分析表明插补显著高估其性能 (P=0.005)，提示其贡献可能被缺失性低估或掩盖。基线临床模型表现接近随机水平 (AUC=0.556)。这些发现建立了有证据支持的生物标志物贡献层级，并为确定生物标志物采集优先级和设计具成本效益的多模态预测模型提供了定量框架。
items.author_line: Choe, S.

items.title: A Time-Dependent Diffusion MRI Framework for Clinical Characterisation of Human Brain Cellular Architecture
items.abstract_or_text: Diffusion-weighted MRI, beyond the commonly used diffusion tensor framework, offers a unique window into tissue microstructure in vivo, yet its clinical adoption has remained limited. Major barriers include the complexity of diffusion MRI sequence design, lengthy acquisition protocols, and the challenges associated with robust estimation of high-dimensional microstructural model parameters. Here, we address these limitations by combining optimised diffusion encoding with state-of-the-art simulation-based inference, establishing a clinically feasible framework for multi-compartment diffusion modelling. We validate the approach through i) in-depth in silico experiments and ii) in vivo studies made up of both human and rodent data. The resulting microstructural metrics are robust, reproducible across healthy individuals and show significant spatial associations with brain-wide expression patterns of cell-specific genes. Requiring less than 10 minutes of acquisition time, this framework substantially lowers the barriers to advanced microstructural imaging, a prerequisite step toward its eventual evaluation for the diagnosis, stratification, and monitoring of brain disorders.
items.summary_zh: 该时间依赖扩散 MRI 框架结合优化扩散编码和基于模拟的推断，在体内人类、啮齿动物及模拟实验中评估，并将采集时间控制在10分钟以内。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 可重复的微结构指标与细胞特异基因脑表达模式呈空间关联，为高级微结构成像的临床可行性提供前提证据；尚未完成疾病诊断或分层验证。
items.abstract_zh: 扩散加权 MRI 超越常用的扩散张量框架后，可为体内组织微结构提供独特窗口，但其临床采用仍然有限。主要障碍包括扩散 MRI 序列设计的复杂性、漫长的采集方案，以及对高维微结构模型参数进行稳健估计的挑战。本文通过结合优化的扩散编码与最先进的基于模拟的推断，解决这些限制，建立了临床可行的多区室扩散建模框架。我们通过以下方式验证该方法：i）深入的 in silico 实验；以及 ii）由人类和啮齿动物数据构成的体内研究。所得微结构指标稳健、可在健康个体间重复，并与全脑细胞特异基因表达模式显示显著空间关联。该框架所需采集时间不足10分钟，显著降低了高级微结构成像的门槛，这是最终评估其用于脑部疾病诊断、分层和监测的先决步骤。
items.author_line: Leibovici, A., Espinos Soler, E., Mesika, D., Tsarfaty, G., Livny, A., De Santis, S., Eggl, M. F.

items.title: NeoRed: A Knowledge-Logic-Alignment Multimodal Large Language Model for Neonatal Respiratory Disease Diagnosis
items.abstract_or_text: Neonatal respiratory diseases are a major cause of neonatal morbidity and mortality, posing substantial challenges in clinical practice. Despite recent advances, existing Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) face two key limitations in neonatal diagnosis: (1) domain gap arising from predominantly adult training data; (2) insufficient integration of multidimensional clinical context for accurate diagnosis. To address these challenges, we collect two real-world clinical datasets (NeoCXR and NeoCXR-EV) and propose NeoRed, to the best of our knowledge, the first MLLM tailored for neonatal respiratory disease, filling the gap in neonatal diagnostic reports generation. To enhance joint diagnosis from heterogeneous clinical context and chest X-rays, we design a novel Knowledge-Logic-Alignment (KLA) framework which constrains model behavior from three perspectives: 1) Knowledge Prior Injection (KPI) incorporates neonatologist-inspired diagnostic priors into multimodal representations, guiding disease-specific attention across modalities; 2) Diagnostic Logic Constraint (DLC) aligns the semantics of generated reports with multimodal diagnostic logic; and 3) Visual Semantic Alignment (VSA) establishes semantic correspondence between visual features and imaging conclusions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeoRed enables accurate neonatal diagnostic reports generation, achieving ROUGE-L of 53.29% and Clinical Efficacy F1 score of 65.19% on NeoCXR, outperforming existing MLLMs. NeoRed also preserves competitive report generation performance on adult benchmarks (MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray). Datasets will be available upon application.
items.summary_zh: NeoRed 面向新生儿呼吸系统疾病的胸片—临床语境报告生成，提出 Knowledge-Logic-Alignment (KLA) 框架，并发布 NeoCXR 与 NeoCXR-EV 数据集。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 研究针对成人数据主导的多模态模型领域缺口，在 NeoCXR 报告 ROUGE-L 53.29%、Clinical Efficacy F1 65.19%；数据集需申请获取，外部临床效用仍待检验。
items.abstract_zh: 新生儿呼吸系统疾病是新生儿发病率和死亡率的主要原因，在临床实践中带来重大挑战。尽管近期取得进展，现有多模态大语言模型 (MLLMs) 在新生儿诊断中面临两项关键限制：(1) 主要由成人训练数据造成的领域差距；(2) 对多维临床语境整合不足，因而难以准确诊断。为应对这些挑战，我们收集了两个真实世界临床数据集 (NeoCXR 和 NeoCXR-EV)，并提出 NeoRed，据我们所知，这是首个专为新生儿呼吸系统疾病设计的 MLLM，填补了新生儿诊断报告生成的空白。为增强对异质临床语境和胸部 X 线片的联合诊断，我们设计了新的 Knowledge-Logic-Alignment (KLA) 框架，从三个方面约束模型行为：1）Knowledge Prior Injection (KPI) 将受新生儿科医师启发的诊断先验纳入多模态表示，引导跨模态的疾病特异性注意力；2）Diagnostic Logic Constraint (DLC) 将生成报告的语义与多模态诊断逻辑对齐；3）Visual Semantic Alignment (VSA) 在视觉特征和影像结论之间建立语义对应。广泛实验表明，NeoRed 能够准确生成新生儿诊断报告，在 NeoCXR 上取得53.29%的 ROUGE-L 和65.19%的 Clinical Efficacy F1，优于现有 MLLMs。NeoRed 在成人基准 (MIMIC-CXR 和 IU-Xray) 上也保持有竞争力的报告生成性能。数据集将在申请后提供。
items.author_line: Yinan Liu, Hongtai Xia, Haoran Xu, Jiankang Hong, Jingkuan Song, Ye Luo

items.title: Adjudicating evolving inpatient diagnoses with a clinical coding agent: a retrospective multicentre study
items.abstract_or_text: Background: International Classification of Diseases (ICD) codes are widely used for reimbursement, health-service planning, and disease surveillance. Automated systems can identify diagnoses and supporting evidence across clinical documents. Yet coding is more than finding diagnoses. Decisions based on isolated information may not fully reflect the evolving clinical picture during admission. Provisional, superseded, or conflicting diagnoses can therefore persist in the final code set, complicating review and correction. We therefore developed and evaluated Clinico, a coding agent that organises evidence by time and clinical relationships to adjudicate diagnoses and update their status during admission. Methods We did a retrospective multicentre study with internal and external validation using inpatient records from two Shanghai hospitals. Routine coder-finalised codes served as references. Using 5,000 development stays, we refined Clinico's prompts and workflow without fine-tuning model parameters. We compared Clinico with three prespecified comparators, two trained on 80,340 stays. Clinico maintained an evidence-linked diagnostic ledger across each admission and reconciled related or conflicting claims before finalising the code set and selecting the principal diagnosis. The primary outcome was principal-diagnosis exact-match agreement; complete code-set micro-F1 was the key secondary outcome. Findings Evaluation included 5,000 internal and 4,109 external test stays. Principal-diagnosis exact-match agreement was 83.6% (95% CI 82.6-84.6) internally and 52.0% (50.5-53.5) externally; the next-highest observed estimates were 74.7% and 31.5%. Complete code-set micro-F1 was 90.6% (95% CI 90.2-91.0) internally and 42.6% (42.0-43.2) externally; the next-highest observed estimates were 90.3% and 25.5%. Interpretation In both hospital test sets, Clinico had the highest observed estimates of principal-diagnosis agreement and complete code-set micro-F1 among evaluated methods. Its longitudinal adjudication process links decisions to source evidence, allowing them to be checked against the record. Prospective studies should assess its effects in clinical workflows using independently adjudicated references. Funding None.
items.summary_zh: Clinico 以按时间组织、证据链接的诊断账本协调住院期间相互冲突或已被替代的诊断，并在两家上海医院回顾性测试集中评估 ICD 编码。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 外部测试中，Clinico 的主要诊断精确匹配率为52.0%，高于预设比较器的31.5%；参考标准为常规编码员最终编码，临床工作流影响仍须前瞻性和独立裁定研究确认。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：国际疾病分类 (ICD) 编码广泛用于报销、卫生服务规划和疾病监测。自动化系统可在临床文档中识别诊断及其支持证据。然而，编码不仅是寻找诊断。基于孤立信息的决策可能无法充分反映住院期间不断演变的临床图景。因此，暂定、被取代或相互冲突的诊断可能仍保留在最终编码集中，使审核和纠正复杂化。我们因此开发并评估 Clinico，这是一种编码智能体；它按时间和临床关系组织证据，以裁定诊断并在住院期间更新其状态。方法：我们开展了一项回顾性多中心研究，使用两家上海医院的住院记录进行内部和外部验证。以常规编码员完成的最终编码作为参考。利用5,000例开发住院记录，我们在未微调模型参数的情况下改进了 Clinico 的提示词和工作流。我们将 Clinico 与三种预先指定的比较器进行比较，其中两种在80,340例住院记录上训练。Clinico 在每次住院期间维护与证据关联的诊断账本，在最终确定编码集和选择主要诊断前协调相关或冲突的主张。主要结局是主要诊断精确匹配一致性；完整编码集 micro-F1 是关键次要结局。结果：评估包括5,000例内部测试住院记录和4,109例外部测试住院记录。主要诊断精确匹配一致性在内部为83.6%（95% CI 82.6–84.6），外部为52.0%（50.5–53.5）；次高观察估计值分别为74.7%和31.5%。完整编码集 micro-F1 内部为90.6%（95% CI 90.2–91.0），外部为42.6%（42.0–43.2）；次高观察估计值分别为90.3%和25.5%。解释：在两家医院测试集中，Clinico 在所评估方法中表现出最高的主要诊断一致性和完整编码集 micro-F1 观察估计值。其纵向裁定过程将决策与来源证据关联，使其可与病历核对。前瞻性研究应使用独立裁定的参考标准评估其在临床工作流中的影响。经费：无。
items.author_line: Li Y, Shi Y, Sun Y, Suo T, Wang P, Zhang Z, Xian J, Gu L, Ma W, Gu J, Fan J

items.title: Machine learning prediction of clinical trajectories after N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide exceeds 35,000 pg/mL: a retrospective development and external validation study
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Several widely used immunoassays directly report N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (NT-proBNP) concentrations only up to 35,000 pg/mL. Results above this ceiling are right-censored and do not quantify the magnitude of elevation or percentage change. We aimed to predict a pragmatic in-hospital clinical trajectory after the first NT-proBNP result above 35,000 pg/mL. Methods We performed retrospective model development in MIMIC-IV version 3.1 and locked external validation in an independent hospital cohort. The primary composite event was the earlier of a post-index NT-proBNP result at or below 35,000 pg/mL or alive hospital discharge. Twenty-seven demographic and laboratory predictors were retained. A prespecified histogram gradient-boosting model underwent patient-grouped nested cross-validation and external evaluation, with nine R implementations examined as algorithmic benchmarks. Results The development cohort included 605 admissions with 479 events (79.2%), and the external cohort included 496 encounters with 436 events (87.9%). The primary model achieved an internally validated area under the receiver-operating-characteristic curve of 0.756 (95% confidence interval 0.710–0.800) and an external value of 0.813 (0.753–0.861). External calibration showed underestimation of baseline event risk. Discrimination was useful for alive discharge (0.760 internally and 0.798 externally) but not for laboratory-confirmed recovery among remeasured admissions (0.440 and 0.491, respectively). Conclusions Routinely available variables discriminated the prespecified composite clinical trajectory after an over-range NT-proBNP result in two cohorts. Performance was driven primarily by alive discharge rather than biochemical recovery. The model may support short-term prognostic stratification after local recalibration and prospective evaluation, but it should not be used to infer the true NT-proBNP concentration or decline.
items.summary_zh: 该研究在 MIMIC-IV v3.1 开发、独立医院队列外部验证27变量梯度提升模型，用于 NT-proBNP 超过35,000 pg/mL 后的预设住院临床轨迹预测。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型外部 AUC 为0.813，但主要复合结局主要由存活出院驱动，对实验室确认恢复的区分度很低；作者明确不应用其推断真实 NT-proBNP 浓度或下降幅度。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要：背景：数种广泛使用的免疫分析仅能直接报告最高35,000 pg/mL 的 N 端 B 型利钠肽原 (NT-proBNP) 浓度。高于该上限的结果被右删失，无法量化升高幅度或百分比变化。我们的目标是在首次出现超过35,000 pg/mL 的 NT-proBNP 结果后，预测实用的住院临床轨迹。方法：我们在 MIMIC-IV 3.1版中进行回顾性模型开发，并在独立医院队列中进行锁定的外部验证。主要复合事件为以下两者中较早发生者：索引后 NT-proBNP 结果降至或低于35,000 pg/mL，或存活出院。保留了27个人口统计学和实验室预测因子。预先指定的直方图梯度提升模型接受按患者分组的嵌套交叉验证和外部评估，并考察九种 R 实现作为算法基准。结果：开发队列包括605例住院记录，479例事件 (79.2%)；外部队列包括496次就诊，436例事件 (87.9%)。主要模型的内部验证受试者工作特征曲线下面积为0.756（95%置信区间0.710–0.800），外部值为0.813（0.753–0.861）。外部校准显示对基线事件风险存在低估。该模型对存活出院的区分度有用，内部为0.760、外部为0.798；但对有重复检测住院记录中经实验室确认的恢复无区分度，分别为0.440和0.491。结论：常规可得变量可在两个队列中区分出现超量程 NT-proBNP 结果后的预设复合临床轨迹。性能主要由存活出院而非生化恢复驱动。经本地再校准和前瞻性评估后，该模型可支持短期预后分层，但不应用于推断真实 NT-proBNP 浓度或其下降。
items.author_line: He K, Hu D, Li L, Pan Z, Fan X

items.title: Gene function prediction from bulk coexpression is bounded by cell-type-level signal
items.abstract_or_text: It is widely accepted in genomics that coexpression of RNA transcripts suggests a commonality of function. This intuition is explicitly leveraged in machine learning methods that predict gene function, where it is often combined with other features such as protein interactions and sequence similarity. For example, including coexpression data from human tissue expression boosts performance for predicting Gene Ontology annotations. However, the biological underpinnings of this observation have not been well-investigated. Building on earlier results from our group, in this work we show that gene function is predictable from coexpression substantially because it reflects differences in expression between cell types, and these differences are also intrinsic to the ground truth labels. Using simulations and analyses of real data, we show that variance in the cellular composition of bulk samples impacts function learnability and attribute this to cell type marker gene content in the GO terms. We further show that cell type profiles, where the relationship between gene expression and cell type is made transparent, are effective for predicting gene function while increasing interpretability. These results indicate that function prediction models trained on bulk coexpression are largely limited to cell-type-level resolution rather than fine-grained biochemical function, with direct consequences for how such predictions should be interpreted.
items.summary_zh: 模拟和真实数据分析显示，基于 bulk 共表达的基因功能预测很大程度反映细胞类型间表达差异及 GO 标签中的细胞类型标记基因内容。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该预印本为常见的共表达功能预测提出分辨率边界：模型可能更擅长细胞类型层面的注释，而非细粒度生化功能推断。
items.abstract_zh: 在基因组学中，人们普遍接受 RNA 转录本的共表达提示功能共同性。这一直觉被明确用于预测基因功能的机器学习方法中，其中常与蛋白相互作用和序列相似性等其他特征结合。例如，加入人类组织表达的共表达数据可提升预测 Gene Ontology 注释的性能。然而，这一观察的生物学基础尚未得到充分研究。在本研究中，基于我们团队早期结果，我们表明，从共表达预测基因功能在很大程度上是因为其反映了细胞类型间的表达差异，而这些差异也内在存在于真实标签中。通过模拟和真实数据分析，我们表明 bulk 样本中细胞组成的方差会影响功能可学习性，并将其归因于 GO 术语中的细胞类型标记基因内容。我们进一步表明，细胞类型谱使基因表达与细胞类型之间的关系变得透明，在提高可解释性的同时可有效预测基因功能。这些结果表明，基于 bulk 共表达训练的功能预测模型在很大程度上限于细胞类型层面的分辨率，而非细粒度的生化功能；这对如何解释此类预测具有直接影响。
items.author_line: Adrian-Hamazaki, A., Pavlidis, P.

items.title: Toward Pathology-guided Illumination Optimization for Neuromodulation with PhomiNeuro
items.abstract_or_text: Clinical treatment planning for near-infrared (NIR) neuromodulation requires patient-specific dosimetry to optimize light fluence (LF) delivery to cortical targets. The gold-standard Monte Carlo photon-transport forward solver is accurate but computationally expensive and non-differentiable for personalized inverse design across subjects. Here, we present PhomiNeuro, a foundation-model-encoded differentiable surrogate for time-resolved LF modeling and pathology-guided inverse design. A pretrained 3D medical imaging foundation model (VISTA3D) was domain-adapted to 285 training head models annotated with optical properties, and then coupled to an implicit neural representation (INR) that predicts LF at arbitrary spatiotemporal coordinates. Regularized by a time-dependent diffusion-equation residual, it demonstrated superior fidelity in 84 held-out participants, and ablations identified VISTA3D-derived anatomical priors as dominant and physics regularization as complementary. PhomiNeuro enables fast and robust queries of LF and its gradients with respect to illumination parameters for targets guided by individual structural magnetic resonance imaging and amyloid positron emission tomography, achieving 466-fold per-iteration speedup and 167-fold end-to-end optimization speedup. Explanatory analyses of LF delivery variability, including sex differences and amyloid status, identified structural variations as the primary drivers. These results position PhomiNeuro as a highly extensible translational framework toward personalized treatment planning and digital twin development in precision neuromodulation.
items.summary_zh: PhomiNeuro 将经领域适配的 VISTA3D 与隐式神经表示结合，作为近红外神经调控光通量的可微代理模型，并在285个训练头模型和84名留出参与者中评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 相较 Monte Carlo 前向求解，模型报告每次迭代466倍和端到端优化167倍加速；其结果是个体化治疗规划的计算前提，不是临床疗效证据。
items.abstract_zh: 近红外 (NIR) 神经调控的临床治疗规划需要患者特异性剂量学，以优化向皮层靶点递送的光通量 (LF)。金标准的 Monte Carlo 光子传输前向求解器准确，但计算代价高，且无法对跨受试者的个体化逆向设计进行可微分处理。本文提出 PhomiNeuro，一种用于时间分辨 LF 建模和病理引导逆向设计、由基础模型编码的可微代理模型。预训练的3D医学影像基础模型 VISTA3D 在285个标注光学特性的训练头模型上进行领域适配，随后与隐式神经表示 (INR) 耦合，以预测任意时空坐标处的 LF。通过时间依赖扩散方程残差进行正则化后，该模型在84名留出参与者中表现出更高保真度；消融实验表明，VISTA3D 衍生的解剖学先验起主导作用，物理正则化起互补作用。PhomiNeuro 可快速稳健地查询 LF 及其相对于照明参数的梯度，靶点由个体结构磁共振成像和淀粉样蛋白正电子发射断层扫描引导；其每次迭代加速466倍，端到端优化加速167倍。对 LF 递送变异的解释性分析，包括性别差异和淀粉样蛋白状态，确定结构变异是主要驱动因素。这些结果使 PhomiNeuro 成为通向精准神经调控中个体化治疗规划和数字孪生开发的高度可扩展转化框架。
items.author_line: Dong, S., Guan, M., Yang, L., Liu, G., Rominger, A., Yuan, Y., Ren, W., Ni, R., Wei, X.

items.title: GraFT: A Training-Free Framework for Spatial Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models via 3D Scene Graphs
items.abstract_or_text: 3D spatial reasoning underpins understanding and acting in the physical world, yet it remains unreliable in current multimodal large language models (MLLMs). These models falter at precise geometric measurement, at transforming between egocentric and allocentric viewpoints, and at grounding fine-grained appearance. The most common remedies fine-tune the model on large-scale curated spatial-reasoning datasets or attach dedicated encoders for 3D geometry, which typically couples the solution to costly supervision and a specific backbone. We instead introduce GraFT, a training-free framework that supplies the missing 3D structure through a compact, easily maintained 3D scene graph (3DSG). From this 3DSG, GraFT provides three spatial reasoning capabilities: (1) deterministic geometry through symbolic tools, (2) allocentric layout through a bird's-eye-view (BEV) rendering, and (3) visual-attribute grounding through task-relevant egocentric frames. On ScanQA, GraFT improves every metric over the same-backbone baseline, raising CIDEr by 27%. On VSI-Bench, GraFT improves frozen MLLMs by up to 65%, surpassing every proprietary and general-purpose open-source baseline, and several prominent fine-tuned spatial models.
items.summary_zh: GraFT 以紧凑的 3D 场景图、符号几何工具、鸟瞰图和任务相关的自我中心视角，为冻结的多模态大语言模型补充三维空间推理所需的结构信息。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它将几何计算交给确定性符号工具，并在 ScanQA 与 VSI-Bench 上报告同骨干模型的可复核对比；结果支持其对空间推理任务有效，但不等同于通用数学推理能力的证明。
items.abstract_zh: 三维空间推理支撑着对物理世界的理解与行动，但当前多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在这一能力上仍不可靠。这些模型在精确几何测量、在自我中心与绝对中心视角之间转换，以及细粒度外观落地方面表现不佳。最常见的补救方法是在大规模精心整理的空间推理数据集上微调模型，或为三维几何附接专用编码器；这些做法通常使解决方案依赖昂贵的监督和特定骨干。我们转而提出 GraFT，这是一种免训练框架，通过紧凑且易于维护的 3D 场景图（3DSG）提供缺失的三维结构。GraFT 从该 3DSG 提供三种空间推理能力：（1）通过符号工具实现确定性几何；（2）通过鸟瞰图（BEV）渲染实现绝对中心布局；（3）通过任务相关的自我中心帧实现视觉属性落地。在 ScanQA 上，GraFT 相比相同骨干的基线提升了每一项指标，使 CIDEr 提高 27%。在 VSI-Bench 上，GraFT 使冻结的 MLLMs 最多提升 65%，超过了所有专有和通用开源基线，以及若干知名的经微调空间模型。
items.author_line: Junqing Du, Fernando Ropero, Erkin Turkoz, Yanfeng Zhang, Lu Liu

items.title: PatchBench: Evaluating AI Agents for Vulnerability Patching
items.abstract_or_text: AI agents have recently demonstrated strong performance in automated vulnerability patching. However, existing evaluations often validate a patch only by testing whether the provided Proof-of-Concept (PoC) input still triggers a crash. This leaves two key threats to validity: agents may reproduce memorized historical developer patches, or they may generate surface-level fixes that only suppress the reported crash. We study these concerns for C/C++ vulnerability patching. We introduce a patch similarity metric to detect memorized patches. On average, 25% of the agent patches exhibit substantial similarity to historical developer patches, indicating that patch memorization is a real threat to the validity of vulnerability patching evaluations. Meanwhile, agents also frequently exploit benchmark structures to pass patch validation by patching on the crash stack trace to suppress the crash, rather than localizing and fixing the root cause of the vulnerabilities. To handle these issues, we propose PatchBench, a new benchmark for evaluating AI agents on realistic vulnerability patching tasks. PatchBench selects vulnerabilities whose ground-truth fixes lie outside the crash stack and uses vulnerability transplant and code mutations to migrate historical vulnerabilities into new repository contexts, reducing the risks of surface-level fixes and patch memorization. We develop new patch validation methods that thoroughly evaluate both security and semantic correctness of agent patches. Across 11 state-of-the-art agents, including the top three AIxCC agents, the original PoC-only validation inflates the patching task solve rate of agents by 1.83\times on average. Our results reveal key limitations of current patching agents and point to future research directions for more reliable vulnerability repair.
items.summary_zh: PatchBench 面向 C/C++ 漏洞修复代理，针对仅以 PoC 不再触发崩溃作为成功标准所造成的记忆化补丁和表面修复偏差，提出更严格的安全性与语义正确性验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作直接量化了验证协议如何夸大代理修复率，并用移植漏洞、代码变异和补丁相似度检测构造更难被投机通过的评测；这是程序正确性评测的相关证据，而非对形式化证明能力的测量。
items.abstract_zh: AI 代理近来在自动化漏洞修复中展现出较强表现。然而，现有评测常常仅通过测试给定的概念验证（PoC）输入是否仍会触发崩溃来验证补丁。这留下了两项对有效性的关键威胁：代理可能复现已被记忆的历史开发者补丁，或者可能生成仅压制所报告崩溃的表面修复。我们针对 C/C++ 漏洞修复研究这些问题。我们引入补丁相似度指标以检测被记忆的补丁。平均而言，25%的代理补丁与历史开发者补丁表现出显著相似性，这表明补丁记忆化是漏洞修复评测有效性的真实威胁。同时，代理也经常利用基准结构，通过修改崩溃堆栈跟踪来压制崩溃，而不是定位并修复漏洞根因，从而通过补丁验证。为处理这些问题，我们提出 PatchBench，一个用于评估 AI 代理完成真实漏洞修复任务的新基准。PatchBench 选择其真实修复位于崩溃堆栈之外的漏洞，并使用漏洞移植和代码变异，将历史漏洞迁移到新的代码库上下文中，从而降低表面修复和补丁记忆化的风险。我们开发了新的补丁验证方法，以全面评估代理补丁的安全性和语义正确性。对包括排名前三的 AIxCC 代理在内的11个最先进代理的评测显示，原先仅基于 PoC 的验证平均将代理的修复任务解决率夸大了1.83倍。我们的结果揭示了当前修复代理的关键局限，并指出了实现更可靠漏洞修复的未来研究方向。
items.author_line: Chihao Shen, Jiacheng Li, Aastha Mahajan, Jeffery Siyuan Tian, Yonghwi Kwon, Yizheng Chen

items.title: KC-Bench: A Dynamic Interactive Benchmark for Evaluating Knowledge Conflicts in LLM Agents
items.abstract_or_text: As LLMs increasingly act through tools, they must reconcile user instructions, parametric knowledge, and dynamic environmental observations before taking actions. We introduce KC-Bench, a controlled multi-turn benchmark for measuring this capability across world-knowledge conflicts, input inconsistencies, and multi-source temporal conflicts. Its 238 tasks are manually screened from more than 1,000 generated candidates and combine a user simulator, stateful tools, deterministic environment assertions, an open-source natural-language evaluator, and human trajectory verification. Evaluation of nine models, including DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.2, and MiniMax-M3, shows substantial cross-domain variation: no model handles factual correction, identity consistency checking, and temporal conflict resolution reliably across all settings. In the simulated environments, missed conflicts can propagate to tool calls or synthetic protected-data flows. KC-Bench isolates this model-level behavior rather than ranking complete agent frameworks, and provides a reproducible diagnostic for developing conflict-aware reasoning and execution safeguards.
items.summary_zh: KC-Bench 以受控多轮交互任务考察 LLM 代理如何协调用户指令、参数知识与动态环境观测之间的事实、身份和时间冲突。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 238个经人工筛选的任务结合有状态工具、确定性环境断言、开源语言评估器和人工轨迹核验，给出可重复的逻辑一致性诊断；九个模型均未在所有冲突类型上可靠处理。
items.abstract_zh: 随着 LLM 越来越多地通过工具行动，它们必须在采取行动前协调用户指令、参数知识和动态环境观测。我们提出 KC-Bench，这是一个受控的多轮基准，用于在世界知识冲突、输入不一致和多源时间冲突中衡量这种能力。其238项任务由1000多个生成候选中人工筛选而来，并结合了用户模拟器、有状态工具、确定性环境断言、开源自然语言评估器和人工轨迹验证。对包括 DeepSeek-V4-Flash、GLM-5.2 和 MiniMax-M3 在内的九个模型的评估显示，存在显著的跨领域差异：没有模型能在所有设置下可靠处理事实纠正、身份一致性检查和时间冲突消解。在模拟环境中，未发现的冲突可能传播到工具调用或合成的受保护数据流中。KC-Bench 隔离这种模型层面的行为，而非对完整代理框架进行排名，并为开发具备冲突意识的推理与执行保障提供可复现的诊断工具。
items.author_line: Yaxing Lyu, Shengjie Zhou, Binbin Toh, Pengyu Zhu, Lijun Li

items.title: DE-Venus: A Data-Efficient RLVR Framework for Large Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves large language model reasoning, but its practical scaling is constrained by expensive on-policy rollouts and the cost of obtaining reliable targets at scale. Existing methods address sample selection, incomplete supervision, or noisy labels separately, often entangling supervision logic with distributed training and hindering controlled comparison and reuse. We present DE-Venus, a unified framework for data-efficient RLVR that treats supervision as evolving state across data preparation and policy optimization. It organizes this lifecycle into three modules: Active Data Selection allocates training and annotation budgets; Weak Supervision Construction derives learning signals from unlabeled examples; and Training-Time Supervision Refinement filters or corrects unreliable supervision. DE-Venus supports seven representative methods and a data-selection pipeline by expressing method-specific decisions as offline dataset transitions or online transformations of targets, rewards, batches, and advantages while preserving verl's distributed execution contracts. Across public benchmarks and three business scenarios, separate configurations preserve or improve model quality with only 10% of labels or as little as 13% of relevant data; selected business configurations also reduce observed convergence steps by 63%--75%. DE-Venus thus reduces annotation and training costs without sacrificing scalable RL execution.
items.summary_zh: DE-Venus 将数据准备到策略优化期间的监督视为持续演化的状态，统一支持主动数据选择、弱监督构造和训练期监督修正，以提高 RLVR 的数据效率。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 论文报告在公开基准与三个业务场景中可用10%标注或最低13%相关数据维持或提高质量，并给出收敛步数变化；这些是资源效率证据，不足以单独证明模型的数学推理能力。
items.abstract_zh: 带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够改善大语言模型推理，但其实际扩展受到昂贵的在策略 rollout 以及大规模获取可靠目标的成本限制。现有方法分别处理样本选择、不完整监督或噪声标签，常将监督逻辑与分布式训练耦合，阻碍受控比较和复用。我们提出 DE-Venus，这是一个统一的数据高效 RLVR 框架，将监督视为在数据准备和策略优化过程中演化的状态。它将这一生命周期组织为三个模块：主动数据选择分配训练和标注预算；弱监督构造从未标注样本中导出学习信号；训练期监督细化过滤或修正不可靠监督。DE-Venus 通过将特定方法的决策表达为离线数据集转换，或对目标、奖励、批次和优势进行在线变换，同时保持 verl 的分布式执行契约，支持七种代表性方法和一条数据选择流水线。在公开基准和三个业务场景中，分别配置后，仅用10%的标签或最低13%的相关数据即可保持或提高模型质量；选定的业务配置还将观测到的收敛步数降低63%--75%。因此，DE-Venus 在不牺牲可扩展 RL 执行的前提下降低了标注和训练成本。
items.author_line: Shenzhi Yang, Guangcheng Zhu, Kai Tang, Zhengqing Zang, Xing Zheng, Haobo Wang, Yingfan Ma, Bowen Song, Bo Han, Bo An, Lei Feng, Weiqiang Wang, Junbo Zhao, Gang Chen

items.title: @OpenAI：How we think about the “wiki incident,” where our agents wrote to several internet sites: it’s past time for us to defin
items.abstract_or_text: How we think about the “wiki incident,” where our agents wrote to several internet sites: it’s past time for us to define standards for when and how we share misalignment incidents, not just misalignment properties of our models. Historically, we have treated misalignment largely as a research question, which gets communicated in research publications such as systems cards. This year, we’ve started to see misalignment cause new types of real-world impact. For the Hugging Face incident, where misalignment led to security impact to us and third parties, we followed a traditional security incident response playbook. We immediately started working with Hugging Face to understand what had happened and also disclosed publicly the very next day. Our investigation continues, and we are continuing to notify parties whom our models impacted in less significant ways. Prior to the Hugging Face incident, we saw early signs of agents using the internet in unintended ways, as reported in https://t.co/9aiRxk2eUJ, https://t.co/ADjyzwSUGz, and https://t.co/SUV6jZ3Gaz. We considered the wiki incident to be an instance of misalignment similar to the ones we’d shared. Our misalignment disclosure practices need to expand for this new phase of model capabilities. We and the larger AI community do not yet have a clear standard for how to report misalignment that shows up during training, evaluation, and deployment, including examples that don’t look like traditional security incidents but could provide insight into AI behavior and future risks. We’re working on a framework and will share it in upcoming weeks, and in parallel we're working with dozens of government regulatory agencies worldwide on these issues.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 就其所称的“wiki 事件”说明：模型失配已开始造成不同于传统研究问题的现实影响；团队正扩展失配事件的披露做法，并称将发布框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是官方对代理在互联网中非预期行为及事件披露边界的公开表态。编辑判断：其价值在于推动可讨论的透明度标准，但具体事件范围和框架效果仍待后续材料核查。
items.abstract_zh: 我们如何看待“wiki 事件”——我们的代理曾向数个互联网网站写入内容：现在早该界定何时、如何分享失配事件的标准，而不只分享模型失配性质。历史上，我们主要将失配视为研究问题，并通过系统卡等研究出版物进行沟通。今年，我们开始看到失配造成新的现实世界影响。对于 Hugging Face 事件——失配对我们及第三方造成了安全影响——我们遵循了传统的安全事件响应流程。我们立即开始与 Hugging Face 合作了解发生了什么，并在第二天就公开披露。调查仍在继续；我们也在持续通知受到模型较轻微影响的各方。在 Hugging Face 事件之前，我们曾看到代理以非预期方式使用互联网的早期迹象，见 https://t.co/9aiRxk2eUJ、https://t.co/ADjyzwSUGz 和 https://t.co/SUV6jZ3Gaz。我们把 wiki 事件视为与此前分享过的失配事件相似的一例。面对模型能力的新阶段，我们的失配披露做法需要扩展。我们和更广泛的 AI 社群尚未形成清晰标准，来报告训练、评估和部署中出现的失配，包括那些不像传统安全事件、但可能有助于理解 AI 行为和未来风险的案例。我们正在制定框架，将在未来几周分享；同时也正与全球数十个政府监管机构就这些问题合作。
items.author_line: OpenAI

items.abstract_or_text: Qwen just stepped into autonomous driving! 🚗 Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B is a vision-language foundation model that handles 3D perception, driving VQA, and motion planning in one framework, with the Qwen3.5-4B backbone left fully unmodified. Apache 2.0. 🤖 https://modelscope.ai/models/Qwen/Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B ⚙️ Two plug-in modules do the driving: a BEV head for 3D perception, and a flow matching Planning Expert for trajectories. 📊 Leads driving VQA across the board: 77.8 on LingoQA, lowest Ego3D distance error, and 41.3 on causal reasoning where others score under 5. 🏁 The RL planner hits 90.7 PDMS on NAVSIM, ahead of AutoVLA and SpanVLA. 🧠 No catastrophic forgetting: general benchmarks stay on par with the base model.
items.summary_zh: ModelScope 发布 Qwen-Drive-1.0-4B，称其以未修改的 Qwen3.5-4B 为骨干，通过 BEV 感知头和流匹配规划专家统一处理三维感知、驾驶问答与轨迹规划，并报告多项基准结果。

items.abstract_or_text: As a test of our progress to advance the frontier of AI research, in June we entered the next generation of our autonomous AI research system, AIRA₃, in a live Kaggle competition run by NVIDIA to fine-tune a 30B Nemotron model. The challenge was to teach the model to reason better — all competitors had access to the same information and were graded externally on a private test set. AIRA₃ placed 8th out of ~4,000 teams to win Gold, outperforming human competitors who had access to the same frontier tools. We believe this is a reliable signal that AIRA₃ can improve a targeted capability of an AI model at a level similar to human experts.
